verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is heavily API-driven. It documents a Cart API (create, commit and cancel sessions), a Feed API for batch catalog uploads, and ACP/UCP tokenization and checkout flows. It also offers webhooks, published OpenAPI definitions on GitHub, and an official MCP server. However, nothing states or shows that every UI (Customer Area) action has an API equivalent, so parity is implied by the API-first design rather than demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity documentation, evidence that configuration and management tasks are exposed via API, independent hands-on corroboration.
